## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass, in the package and in `example/`.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests.
- [ ] New public API has doc comments.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry.
- [ ] Visual changes include before and after screenshots.
- [ ] Still works with a keyboard, a screen reader, and reduced motion.
- [ ] No breaking change, or the breaking change is explained above.
